subject: corridor
fact: The corridor has a stone floor with bodies in Earth Temple brown and Fire Temple red, already cooling in the scalding scalding air.
source_quote: Stone floor. Bodies in Earth Temple brown and Fire Temple red, already cooling in the scalding air.

subject: corridor
fact: The corridor contains an improvised barricade of pews and rubble.
source_quote: Bugbears behind an improvised barricade of pews and rubble,

subject: bugbears
fact: Bugbears are behind the barricade holding the stairway against an Earth Temple advance.
source_quote: Bugbears behind an improvised barricade of pews and rubble, holding the stairway against an Earth Temple advance

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple has an advance that has stalled in the haze ahead of the party.
source_quote: holding the stairway against an Earth Temple advance that had stalled somewhere in the haze ahead of us.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple line fractures after the barricade is destroyed.
source_quote: the Fire Temple line fractured into the exact kind of chaotic mess that we had specifically engineered this situation to produce.

subject: gray ooze
fact: The steam is generated by elemental violence that is not winding down.
source_quote: Elemental violence has a way of feeding itself, and whatever was generating this particular environmental nightmare was not winding down.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr puts an arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor.
source_quote: Zephyr put an arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor

subject: Zinnia's strike
fact: Zinnia strikes and drops the cultist at the front of the line before the bugbears process her presence.
source_quote: The cultist at the front of their line didn't see me coming. ... The cultist dropped before the bugbears had finished processing that we were there.

subject: Zinnia's injury
fact: Zinnia takes a critical blow that reorganizes her understanding of the fight.
source_quote: The blow took something real from what remained, landing on a body that had just committed fully to the attack and had nowhere to go.

subject: Calmer's divine radiance
fact: Calmer releases a pulse of guiding radiance that causes the double doors at the barricade to stop existing as an obstacle.
source_quote: A single pulse of guiding radiance, the kind of divine light that doesn't ask permission, and the double doors at the barricade simply *stopped existing as an obstacle*.

subject: barricade destroyed
fact: The barricade is destroyed when the double doors fly open.
source_quote: They flew open with the kind of finality that makes everyone on both sides pause for half a breath.

subject: Zephyr kills first bugbear
fact: Zephyr works through the first bugbear with methodical efficiency.
source_quote: I watched Zephyr work through the first bugbear with a methodical efficiency that I don't say enough good things about.

subject: Sequoia kills second bugbear
fact: Sequoia delivers a finishing blow on the second bugbear with satisfying weight.
source_quote: Sequoia's finishing blow on the second had a certain satisfying weight to it.

subject: Air Temple passage
fact: The Air Temple passage is dark and contains a wraith drifting ahead.
source_quote: I came around the bend into the Air Temple passage and there it was, drifting in the dark ahead of us.

subject: wraith
fact: A wraith is present in the Air Temple passage and resists two attempts of divine light from Calmer.
source_quote: The wraith looked at it. And did not flinch. ... The wraith held against it again.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer channels divine light from St. Cuthbert, Cudgel of Ortho, the Arbiter Eternal, twice against the wraith.
source_quote: I gathered the light. I thrust it outward — the real thing, the genuine article, the power that has cracked ghoul skulls and sent lesser dead screaming into whatever passes for oblivion on the other side. ... I tried again.

subject: St. Cuthbert
fact: St. Cuthbert is referenced as the deity whose training guides Calmer’s response to undead.
source_quote: I knew before I turned the corner. Not by sight or sound — by the particular wrongness that St. Cuthbert's training leaves in a cleric who has seen enough of what shouldn't exist.

subject: St. Cuthbert
fact: St. Cuthbert is referred to as the Cudgel of Ortho and the Arbiter Eternal.
source_quote: The divine light of St. Cuthbert, Cudgel of Ortho, the Arbiter Eternal, dispersed twice into the air of a dank dungeon corridor

subject: wraith speaks
fact: The wraith says, 'Well, one of you is going to die today.'
source_quote: the wraith ... said, with what I can only describe as serene confidence: "Well, one of you is going to die today."

subject: Zephyr shoots wraith
fact: Zephyr raises his pistol and wounds the wraith across its torso.
source_quote: Zephyr raised his pistol. The shot caught the wraith across what might generously be called its torso — a wound that barely registered on something like this

subject: party flees
fact: The party begins dashing through the Air Temple corridor in a non-tactical retreat.
source_quote: The party began dashing. One by one, boots loud on stone, the Air Temple corridor filling with the very specific sound of adventurers not fighting a tactical retreat but simply *running*.

subject: Calmer is struck by wraith
fact: The wraith reaches out and catches Calmer across the back with a cold, deep blow.
source_quote: The wraith reached out as I sprinted and caught me across the back. A blow that cost something real, cold and deep,

subject: Calmer is struck by fire bolt
fact: A stray bolt of fire adds insult to Calmer’s injury as he clears the threshold.
source_quote: and then a stray bolt of fire from somewhere in the chaos added its own insult on top

subject: wraith laughs
fact: The wraith laughs hysterically as the party escapes up the stairs.
source_quote: came the sound of the wraith laughing at me. *Hysterically.* It laughed at me *hysterically*.

subject: corridor
fact: The corridor where ghouls ambush the party smells of wet rot and something unnatural.
source_quote: The smell arrived before the sound. That sick, wet rot — like meat left in standing water, but with something worse underneath it, something that didn't belong to the natural world at all.

subject: ghouls
fact: Four ghouls emerge from the dark, shambling in a line.
source_quote: They came out of the dark in a shambling line — four of them

subject: ghouls
fact: The ghouls are former Earth Temple members, recently raised.
source_quote: Earth Temple members. People we'd seen in corridors, nodded to while maintaining cover, filed away as *useful* or *obstacle* in the ongoing arithmetic of survival. Now raised by something with necromantic ambitions

subject: Sequoia's trap fails
fact: Sequoia’s trap mechanism fails early, and the ghouls keep coming.
source_quote: the mechanism failed at the worst possible moment — the kind of failure that makes you want to reconsider your life choices. The spring went early, the delay was nothing, and the ghouls kept coming.

subject: Zephyr kills first ghoul
fact: Zephyr kills the nearest ghoul with a clean, precise dagger strike before it can react.
source_quote: The dagger was already in my hand. Clean. Precise. The creature dropped where it stood like someone had simply switched it off.

subject: Calmer unleashes divine power on ghouls
fact: Calmer releases divine power that causes the three remaining ghouls to flee in terror.
source_quote: Calmer let the undead have it. The holy wrath came out of him like something that had been stored under pressure for weeks. It hit the room — all three remaining ghouls unable to hold against it, every last one of them — and they *fled*.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer says 'yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!' as he channels divine power against the ghouls.
source_quote: Calmer was going "yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!"

subject: Sequoia kills last ghoul
fact: Sequoia puts an arrow in the back of the last ghoul before it escapes the corridor.
source_quote: Sequoia put an arrow in the back of the last one before it made it out the corridor.

subject: Calmer's transformation
fact: Zephyr wonders whether Calmer's outburst against the ghouls is him or something else wearing his voice.
source_quote: The second thought was quieter and I didn't linger on it. The second thought was: *is that him, or is that something else wearing his voice?*

subject: necromantic presence
fact: Someone with necromantic power is working in the dungeon, using corpses of Earth Temple members.
source_quote: Someone with necromantic power was working in this dungeon right now, during our carefully engineered war, with access to our people's corpses and apparent interest in deploying them.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag is referenced in Zephyr's thoughts as part of the operation's context.
source_quote: thinking about Romag and Hartsch and the seventeen ways this whole operation could collapse before morning.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is referenced in Zephyr's thoughts as part of the operation's context.
source_quote: thinking about Romag and Hartsch and the seventeen ways this whole operation could collapse before morning.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor is referenced as having drowned Calmer with magic.
source_quote: He has been burned by fire priests and drowned by Thalsor's magic

subject: Calmer revived
fact: Calmer was revived at considerable cost by someone who claims not to care about him.
source_quote: I have been killed once already in this gods-forsaken temple, revived at considerable cost to someone who claims not to care about me

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia expressed concern that Calmer was going native.
source_quote: the concern Zinnia had put into words once, something about Calmer going native

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer's breathing slowly returned to something resembling normal.
source_quote: The sounds of Calmer's breathing slowly returned to something resembling normal.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr was still moving like something inside him wasn't quite right.
source_quote: Zephyr was still moving like something inside him wasn't quite right.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia watched the prisoner the whole time and gave a look that meant 'this one's telling the truth.'
source_quote: Zinnia had been watching the man the whole time. I saw him do that thing: the small stillness, the focused attention. He's good at reading people. Better than he lets on, and he already lets on plenty. Whatever he saw, it settled something, because he gave me the look that means: this one's telling the truth.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is the Air Temple cleric who sat across from Romag's table like furniture.
source_quote: Kelno's people. The Air Temple cleric who had sat across from Romag's table like furniture, quiet enough that I'd filed him under background noise and moved on.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag's anger is one of the loud players in the faction politics of the temples.
source_quote: Romag's anger. The Fire Temple's fire. The Water Temple's ambition.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch summoned the Obsidian Edge for a war council immediately.
source_quote: Hartsch wanted them. Hartsch wanted his Obsidian Edge assembled, upstairs, immediately. War council. The summons had the texture of now.

subject: the freed prisoner
fact: The freed prisoner knew about the Deep Temple and revealed a hidden passage inside the Air Temple.
source_quote: I guess I would be pushing my luck if I insisted for more help, wouldn't I? My mother never raised — didn't raise me to be a fool. Alright. So here's the secret door to the Greater Temple.

subject: the freed prisoner
fact: The freed prisoner received his information about the Deep Temple directly from Kelno.
source_quote: knowledge he'd gotten directly from Kelno — which meant it was the kind of information that doesn't circulate widely, the kind you only know if you were close enough to matter or close enough to overhear.

subject: the freed prisoner
fact: The freed prisoner's mother raised him not to be a fool.
source_quote: My mother never raised — didn't raise me to be a fool.

subject: the runner
fact: An Earth Temple runner arrived with a summons from Hartsch for the Obsidian Edge.
source_quote: An Earth Temple runner, collar damp with effort, mouth already open before he'd finished stopping. Hartsch wanted them. Hartsch wanted his Obsidian Edge assembled, upstairs, immediately. War council. The summons had the texture of now.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple cleric Kelno used the chaos of the temple war to loot and expand his own resources.
source_quote: Kelno had read the board and decided his move was to let the other temples destroy each other while his people walked the corridors with empty bags and filled them.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple is one of the loud players in the faction politics of the temples.
source_quote: Romag's anger. The Fire Temple's fire. The Water Temple's ambition.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is one of the loud players in the faction politics of the temples.
source_quote: Romag's anger. The Fire Temple's fire. The Water Temple's ambition.

subject: Obsidian Edge
fact: The Obsidian Edge lit the match in the war between the temples and stepped back.
source_quote: The Obsidian Edge had lit the match and stepped back, and now Kelno was standing in the smoke with a different set of burns and a full treasury.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple summoned the Obsidian Edge for a war council.
source_quote: An Earth Temple runner, collar damp with effort, mouth already open before he'd finished stopping. Hartsch wanted them. Hartsch wanted his Obsidian Edge assembled, upstairs, immediately. War council. The summons had the texture of now.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple contains a wraith in a corridor that does not move as the party passes.
source_quote: When we moved back through the Air Temple, the wraith was where we'd left it. Same corridor. Same cold. Same hollow patience.

subject: second level corridors
fact: The second level corridors have broken bottles scattered across the floor like someone had celebrated early and poorly.
source_quote: Broken bottles scattered across the floor like someone had celebrated early and poorly.

subject: second level corridors
fact: The second level corridors have armor shoved against the walls, not placed, but cleared in a hurry.
source_quote: Armor shoved against the walls — not placed, shoved, the way you clear a path in a hurry.

subject: second level corridors
fact: The second level corridors have blood trails running into shadow and stopping nowhere near a body.
source_quote: Blood trails running into shadow and stopping nowhere near a body.

subject: Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife
fact: The Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife has mummified heads on the walls with leather-dry mouths twisted in dying expressions.
source_quote: The trophies on the walls said as much: mummified heads, their leather-dry mouths still twisted in the expressions of their dying moments.

subject: Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife
fact: The Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife has torn battle standards on the walls.
source_quote: The trophies on the walls said as much: mummified heads, their leather-dry mouths still twisted in the expressions of their dying moments. Torn battle standards.

subject: Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife
fact: The Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife has battered shields on the walls.
source_quote: The trophies on the walls said as much: mummified heads, their leather-dry mouths still twisted in the expressions of their dying moments. Torn battle standards. Battered shields.

subject: Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife
fact: The Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife has a broken broadsword kept as a trophy.
source_quote: A broken broadsword that someone had kept as a trophy, which meant someone had once been proud of breaking it.

subject: Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife
fact: The Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife has tapestries showing raiding figures in the act of taking, burning, dragging.
source_quote: The tapestries showed raiding — figures in the act of taking, burning, dragging.

subject: Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife
fact: The Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife has broad steps of dull black stone descending from the north wall into shadow.
source_quote: Broad steps of dull black stone descended from the north wall into shadow, and the silence of the place pressed down like a thumb.

subject: Prisoner chamber
fact: The prisoner chamber smells like fear and old stone, with a combination of unwashed people, iron, and faint copper.
source_quote: The chamber smelled like fear and old stone. That particular combination — unwashed people, iron, the faint copper of something that had happened here before we arrived — I've learned to read it the way a sailor reads weather.

subject: Prisoner chamber
fact: The prisoner chamber has four prisoners still chained to the wall after one was freed.
source_quote: The other four were still chained to the wall.

subject: bags
fact: Goblins hauled bags that clinked with the unmistakable weight of coin.
source_quote: hauling bags that clinked with the unmistakable weight of coin.

subject: lock
fact: The lock on the prisoner's shackles gave cleanly when picked.
source_quote: I stepped forward, crouched down, and got to work. The lock gave cleanly.

subject: shackles
fact: The shackles on the prisoners came apart like they'd been waiting to be picked.
source_quote: The shackles came apart like they'd been waiting for me.

subject: goblins
fact: Goblins were moving through a hidden door, hauling bags of coin.
source_quote: I saw the goblins. They were moving through a hidden door that had no business being visible, hauling bags that clinked with the unmistakable weight of coin.

subject: ghouls
fact: Ghouls were dragging looted weapons through the same passage as the goblins.
source_quote: Behind them, ghouls. Ghouls. Dragging looted weapons, threading the same passage with the same purposeful efficiency.

subject: fire snakes
fact: Fire snakes were locked in combat with water gargoyles in the Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife.
source_quote: Fire snakes and a wounded salamander, locked in combat with four water gargoyles

subject: salamander
fact: A wounded salamander was locked in combat with water gargoyles in the Hall of Trophies and Elemental Strife.
source_quote: Fire snakes and a wounded salamander, locked in combat with four water gargoyles

subject: water gargoyles
fact: Four water gargoyles were locked in combat with fire snakes and a wounded salamander.
source_quote: Fire snakes and a wounded salamander, locked in combat with four water gargoyles

subject: wraith
fact: A wraith was present in the Air Temple corridor and did not move as the party passed.
source_quote: When we moved back through the Air Temple, the wraith was where we'd left it. Same corridor. Same cold. Same hollow patience.

subject: Calmer's breathing returning to normal
fact: Calmer's breathing slowly returned to something resembling normal.
source_quote: The sounds of Calmer's breathing slowly returned to something resembling normal.

subject: the wraith drifting away
fact: The wraith drifted away after the party passed through its territory.
source_quote: I didn't look back when I heard it drift away.

subject: the party reaching the second level
fact: The party reached the second level and noted cooler air, the smell of blood and old stone, and broken bottles on the floor.
source_quote: The second level hit different the moment we reached it. Cooler air. The smell of blood and old stone. Broken bottles scattered across the floor like someone had celebrated early and poorly.

subject: the goblins and ghouls moving through the hidden door
fact: Goblins and ghouls moved through a hidden door, hauling loot with purposeful efficiency.
source_quote: They were moving through a hidden door that had no business being visible, hauling bags that clinked with the unmistakable weight of coin. Behind them, ghouls. Ghouls. Dragging looted weapons, threading the same passage with the same purposeful efficiency.

subject: the party noticing the door in the Hall of Trophies
fact: A door in the Hall of Trophies opened on its own, then closed again.
source_quote: This one opened on its own. Not dramatically — not with a gust of wind or the grinding of ancient mechanisms. Just: open, when it had been closed a moment before. Then closed again.

subject: the party escaping the elemental battle
fact: The party slipped away south during the elemental battle using the steam for cover.
source_quote: We moved between the billows, staying low, staying quiet, letting the heat swallow the sound of our passage.

subject: the salamander's shriek
fact: The salamander's shriek cut through the elemental battle once.
source_quote: The salamander's shriek cut through once.

subject: the prisoner being freed
fact: The lock on the prisoner's shackles was picked and the shackles came apart.
source_quote: I stepped forward, crouched down, and got to work. The lock gave cleanly. The shackles came apart like they'd been waiting for me.

subject: the prisoner revealing the hidden passage
fact: The freed prisoner revealed a secret door to the Greater Temple inside the Air Temple.
source_quote: Alright. So here's the secret door to the Greater Temple.

subject: Zephyr receiving the summons
fact: Zephyr received a summons from Hartsch for the Obsidian Edge to assemble immediately.
source_quote: Hartsch wanted them. Hartsch wanted his Obsidian Edge assembled, upstairs, immediately. War council. The summons had the texture of now.

subject: the door that moves on its own
fact: A door that moves on its own in the Hall of Trophies is being watched by someone or something.
source_quote: Someone, or something, was tracking our position.

subject: the prisoner's mother
fact: The freed prisoner's mother raised him not to be a fool.
source_quote: My mother never raised — didn't raise me to be a fool.

subject: the Rhennee debt
fact: Zephyr filed the Rhennee debt among the things he planned to collect later.
source_quote: He filed the directions away in the same place he kept everything he planned to collect later: the Rhennee debt, Captain Tolub's ship schedule, the exact weight of every favor he was owed.

subject: Captain Tolub's ship schedule
fact: Zephyr filed Captain Tolub's ship schedule among the things he planned to collect later.
source_quote: He filed the directions away in the same place he kept everything he planned to collect later: the Rhennee debt, Captain Tolub's ship schedule, the exact weight of every favor he was owed.

subject: favors owed
fact: Zephyr filed the exact weight of every favor he was owed among the things he planned to collect later.
source_quote: He filed the directions away in the same place he kept everything he planned to collect later: the Rhennee debt, Captain Tolub's ship schedule, the exact weight of every favor he was owed.

subject: the current day
fact: The party's actions occur before morning, implying the current day is ongoing.
source_quote: I thought about how many locks I still had to pick tonight, and what we still needed to do before morning

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch whistled and the Obsidian Edge came running.
source_quote: Hartsch whistled and the Obsidian Edge came running

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch was useful and useful things required maintenance.
source_quote: Hartsch was useful and useful things required maintenance

subject: Obsidian Edge
fact: The Obsidian Edge came running when Hartsch whistled.
source_quote: Hartsch whistled and the Obsidian Edge came running

subject: alliance with Hartsch
fact: The alliance with Hartsch was real.
source_quote: The alliance was real

subject: leash attached to the alliance
fact: The leash attached to the alliance with Hartsch was also real.
source_quote: The leash attached to it was also real

subject: door's location
fact: The door's location sat behind his eyes like money he hadn't spent yet.
source_quote: The door's location sat behind his eyes like money he hadn't spent yet
